title: Fake Backpacker Job
scenario: A hostel contact offers paid work but asks for passport scans and fees first.

answers.A: Check inside the official app, booking, provider, or government site.
answers.B: Click/pay immediately to avoid losing the booking or offer.
answers.C: Forward it to a fellow traveller and ask what they think.
answers.D: Ignore/report the message and use a known contact route.

explanation: Fake Backpacker Job: the trap is to collect private data, images, or documents under pressure. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to click or follow the risky request.
proTip: Working-travel offers need legal and employer verification.
